description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

B4Corp is hiring a Software Engineer to support an unnamed customer’s applications development. The role supports frontend and backend applications and services used to improve producer experience and facilitate the production of complex visual products, as well as cloud-based infrastructure.
Level 2 Expert Software Engineer supporting frontend and backend applications for producer workflows and complex visual production.

Requirements:
• Position Requires a Top Secret (TS/SCI) Clearance with a Polygraph
• Demonstrated experience with frontend and backend application development support for applications and services used to improve producer experience
• Demonstrated experience with frontend and backend application development support for applications and services used to facilitate the production of complex visual products
• Demonstrated experience with version control software including Git and GitHub
• Demonstrated experience with presentational development including HTML5/CSS3, Hugo or other static site generators, and SASS
• Demonstrated experience with functional development including Javascript, Angular, Vue, React and Node.js
• Demonstrated experience with any combination of the following; Typescript, Webpack, Lerna, or Electron
• Demonstrated experience with cloud-based infrastructure development and automation including AWS, AWS CloudFormation, AWS CloudWatch, and AWS S3, AWS ELB
• Demonstrated experience with any of the following (experience with all three libraries is a plus); Express.js, Koa.js, or NGINX
• Demonstrated experience with any of the following; RDS, MySQL, or Dynamo DB
